title: Restricted augmented lift computes the cohomology map
statement: Let f:X→S and g:S′→S be scheme morphisms, F an O_X-module, I an injective resolution of F, J an injective resolution of g′^*F for g′:S′×_S X→X, and t:I→g′_*J a map whose augmentation is the adjunction unit of F. Fix V⊆S, p∈ℕ, and D:FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Put h=g′ restricted to g′⁻¹(f⁻¹V), and q=flatBaseChangeResolutionQ f g I J t [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-resolution-construction]. Then resolutionSectionHomology for D.source followed by Hᵖ(pushforwardComplexSections g q V) equals moduleCohomologyFMap h D.psi p [def-weil-pbc-module-cohomology-fmap] followed by resolutionSectionHomology for D.target, using the fibre-product equality of inverse-image opens. The transport maps are [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-section-complex]. This is an equality of additive-group morphisms before any cocycle-to-sheaf map, with no flatness assumption.

proof.text: Restrict t to U=f⁻¹V and transport with the augmentation-preserving source and target comparisons in D. The restriction/direct-image comparison and D.unit_square give a map r of restricted resolutions whose augmentation is D.psi followed by the target augmentation. D.source.components and D.target.components identify its section map with evaluation of q, using the fibre-product open equality.

Resolve the pushed target restricted complex by lambda into a bounded-below injective complex, using extension by zero and truncation for natural indexing. Use lambda after r as the horizontal map in the choice-data construction. Sections of lambda induce invertible homology maps; cancel the vertical map and its inverse. Independence of choice data identifies this computation with the recorded cohomology h-map. Transport through the two resolution section isomorphisms to obtain the equality. The argument works for p=0, zero coefficients and empty opens.

theorem flatBaseChangeRestrictedLift_homology {X S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S) {F : X.Modules}
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (t : I.cocomplex ⟶ ((pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (ht : I.ι.f 0 ≫ t.f 0 =
      (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd g f))).unit.app F ≫
        (pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).map (J.ι.f 0))
    (V : S.Opens) (D : FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V) (p : ℕ) :
    resolutionSectionHomology D.source.resolution
      (((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex)
      V D.source.sections p ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} (ComplexShape.up ℕ) p).map
        (pushforwardComplexSections g (flatBaseChangeResolutionQ f g I J t) V) =
    moduleCohomologyFMap ((pullback.snd g f).resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl) D.psi p ≫
    resolutionSectionHomology D.target.resolution
      (((pushforward (pullback.fst g f)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex) (g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      (D.target.sections ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (fun U ↦
        ((RingedSpace.openModuleSections
          (Limits.pullback g f).toRingedSpace U).mapHomologicalComplex
           (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
            (flatBaseChangeOpenEquality f g V))) p
